tasks.label: debug-sync-connector
tasks.command:
docker compose exec api python -c "
import asyncio, traceback
from src.data.database import primary_session_factory
from src.knowledge_sources.repositories.knowledge_source_repository import KnowledgeSourceRepository
from src.knowledge_sources.sync.executor import SyncJobExecutor, SyncExecutorSettings
from src.connector_sdk.registry import ConnectorRegistry
from sqlalchemy import text
from uuid import UUID

async def main():
    async with primary_session_factory()() as session:
        repo = KnowledgeSourceRepository(session)
        source = await repo.get_by_id(UUID('940f9c3b-c414-4e01-b116-37fa8570a864'))
        if source:
            print('name               :', source.name)
            print('connector_type     :', source.connector_type)
            print('credentials_vault_path:', source.credentials_vault_path)
            print('scope              :', source.scope)
            print('status             :', source.status)
        else:
            print('Source not found')
            return
        # Try building connector to see what errors occur
        registry = ConnectorRegistry()
        settings = SyncExecutorSettings()
        executor = SyncJobExecutor(session, registry, settings)
        print('--- Attempting _build_connector_for_source ---')
        try:
            connector = await executor._build_connector_for_source(source)
            print('Connector built and authenticated OK:', type(connector).__name__)
        except Exception as e:
            print('ERROR building connector:', type(e).__name__, str(e))
            traceback.print_exc()

asyncio.run(main())
"

tasks.label: check-vault-token
tasks.command:
docker compose exec api python -c "
import asyncio
import hvac
from src.knowledge_sources.config import KnowledgeSourceSettings

s = KnowledgeSourceSettings()
client = hvac.Client(url=s.vault_addr)
client.auth.approle.login(role_id=s.vault_role_id, secret_id=s.vault_secret_id)

try:
    secret = client.secrets.kv.v2.read_secret_version(
        path='connectors/github/my-org-pat',
        mount_point='secret'
    )
    data = secret['data']['data']
    token = data.get('token', '')
    token_type = data.get('token_type', 'unknown')
    print('token_type:', token_type)
    print('token starts with:', token[:8] + '...' if len(token) > 8 else repr(token))
    print('token length:', len(token))
except Exception as e:
    print('ERROR reading from vault:', e)
"
